transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess my head just feels sort of... foggy lately. I keep making these little mistakes in my client notes at work, or... just forgetting what I was about to do. It's not really like me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.

Have you noticed any other changes in your thinking or memory besides feeling foggy and making mistakes in your notes? For example, trouble finding words, getting lost in familiar places, or difficulty making decisions?

Um, no, not really. Not getting lost or anything like that. It's mostly just... like I said, the fog. Just losing track of what I was about to do, and those mistakes with the paperwork. I haven't really noticed anything else.
Have you been feeling more down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Um... I guess a little. I mean... I still get through my shifts fine. I talk to the clients and everything. But... yeah, I don't know. Lately I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. Just sort of empty in my chest. Like even though I'm doing my job, inside I'm just... sad and flat, I guess.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?
Um... I guess so. I don't really do much outside of work anyway, so... it's hard to tell. But yeah, I suppose I don't really feel like doing much of anything right now.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even if you're not doing anything physically demanding?

Yeah, I guess so. Just... tired. Even if I'm not doing much, my body just feels worn out. Like, just helping a client shower or... carrying groceries inside, it just takes more out of me than it should. I don't know why.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating more or less than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
Um... no, not really. I think I'm eating about the same. Haven't noticed any weight changes or anything.
How long have you been feeling this way—like you're sad, tired, and having trouble concentrating?
Um... probably about a month. Just this... low, foggy feeling. Feeling guilty about things, I guess. It's just been hanging over me for a month now.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately, like waking up too early or not being able to fall asleep, or on the flip side, do you find yourself sleeping a lot more than usual?
Yeah, it's been kind of... all over the place. Sometimes I just lie in bed, thinking about... family stuff, I guess. Or I'll wake up way before my alarm and just can't really settle back down.
Have you ever felt this way before, or is this the first time you've experienced these symptoms?
Um... I don't know. Maybe. It's hard to remember. I just... I know I feel this way right now.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt persistently sad, tired, and had trouble concentrating, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I mean... like I said, I really couldn't tell you. I don't usually pay that much attention to it. I just go to work and do my job, you know? I haven't really noticed if it's happened before... just that I'm dealing with it now.
Can you recall if there was a time before this current period when you felt persistently down, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for at least two weeks?
I don't... I mean, I don't really keep track of weeks like that. Maybe? I just... I try to just focus on getting through the day. I don't really look back and measure how long I felt a certain way.
Looking back, can you remember if there was a time before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for a couple of weeks or more?
Look, I... I don't know what else to tell you. Like I just said, I don't keep track of things like that. I just... I really don't remember.
Can you think of a time before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for two weeks or more?
I... you're asking me the exact same thing again. No. I really can't.
Can you think of a time before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for two weeks or more?
I... I just answered that. The answer is still no. I don't remember.
Have you ever had a period lasting several weeks or more in the past when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating before this current time?
I... look, I don't know why you keep asking me that. I really don't. The answer is still no. I don't have anything else to add.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for more than two weeks at a time?
I... I really don't have a different answer for you. It's still no. I haven't.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for more than two weeks at a time?
I... I don't know what you want me to say at this point. No. Just... no.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for more than two weeks at a time?
Are you just... reading the same question again? Because I've already told you. No. I haven't.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things, or had trouble concentrating for more than two weeks at a time?
...No. Still no. I really don't have anything else to say about it. Can we just move on?
